properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDSA over secp256r1 ("Secp256r1") is one of Sui's four user signature schemes (flag 0x01): SuiKeyPair::Secp256r1 in sui-types, multisig member support, and the WebAuthn passkey scheme (ES256). Production surfaces: GraphQL/RPC signature verification types, bridge key utils, rosetta. Quantum-vulnerable (Shor); migrate to ML-DSA-65. Judgement basis: page 1 of 13 paged; all 25 sampled sites individually confirmed; remaining sites follow the same pattern.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDSA across the repo: P-256 ECDSA for passkey/WebAuthn verification paths (p256::ecdsa VerifyingKey/Signature in e2e tests mirroring production verification in sui-types), the Cargo.toml p256 "ecdsa" feature, rosetta's Ecdsa-to-Secp256k1 mapping, and the ecdsa-sig-formatter npm dep. The secp256k1 production signing is tracked by the secp256k1 object; this object is the P-256 side.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 (SHA-3 family) across the Sui bridge: Ethereum function-selector derivation (Keccak256::digest in sui-bridge-cli, bridge_client, encoding.rs), Ethereum address derivation (crypto.rs:43), and keccak256 in the Axelar presets. The sui_bridge.json sites are keccak256 method-selector hashes in the committed ABI — real recorded values tied to the same algorithm, not names-only.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 32 sites use rand::rngs::OsRng (getrandom-backed OS CSPRNG) or getrandom directly — the key-generation randomness for validator authority keys, network/account keys and bridge keys (e.g. sui-bridge/src/config.rs:164, sui-genesis-builder, sui keytool genesis flows). This is the good-posture end of the RNG spectrum: OS CSPRNG, no insecure seeding found in these sites. Not quantum-relevant; recorded as the repo's randomness source.
